messages.subject: Rattle Uses
parts:
Good Morning,

I am hoping to put together a list for graham, of some of the projects that Rattle has been used for. So if you have used rattle to perform some analysis, or to in a project, could you please put down a line or two to go on a webpage.

eg

Weather Analysis - I use Rattle to predict rain fall, using models, explore data and some charts.

Just some thing simple, but we can give others ideas on how useful the software is.

Regards
Tony Nolan
